title: Agile Cells
label: Voice made by AI · no presenter · every claim sourced

from.what: The storyboard of the Agile Cells film

scenes.title: The proposition
scenes.narration: Agile is great. But it struggles to scale. Now we have a way to make it scale: Agile Cells.

sources.claim: The Sovereign Website team's proposition, in Dinis Cruz's words of 28 November 2026: 'Agile is great, but it struggles to scale ... now we have a way to make it scale.'
sources.title: Agile Cells: the production, with Dinis Cruz's feedback of 28 November 2026

scenes.on_screen: A small team strains as it grows, then splits into cells. Agile Cells.

scenes.title: Four values
scenes.narration: In 2001, seventeen people wrote four values. The first: Individuals and interactions over processes and tools.

sources.claim: The Manifesto's four values, word for word; seventeen names; '© 2001, the above authors'.
sources.title: Manifesto for Agile Software Development

scenes.on_screen: Individuals and interactions over processes and tools; Working software over comprehensive documentation; Customer collaboration over contract negotiation; Responding to change over following a plan

scenes.title: The values are sound
scenes.narration: As one of its authors, Ron Jeffries, wrote in 2018: the values and principles of the Manifesto still offer the best way I know to build software. The values are sound. What hardens, as it grows, is the word, and the way it is run.

quotes.quote: the values and principles of the Manifesto for Agile Software Development still offer the best way I know to build software

sources.claim: Ron Jeffries, May 2018: 'the values and principles of the Manifesto for Agile Software Development still offer the best way I know to build software'.
sources.title: Developers Should Abandon Agile

sources.claim: The Sovereign Website team's reading, in Dinis Cruz's words: 'the principles are sound. It's just that the word Agile, but also the execution, becomes quite solidified.'
sources.title: Agile Cells: the production, with Dinis Cruz's feedback of 28 November 2026

scenes.on_screen: “the values and principles of the Manifesto for Agile Software Development still offer the best way I know to build software” (Ron Jeffries, 2018). Four warm lights inside a hardening shell.

scenes.title: What a cell is
scenes.narration: Agile Cells keeps the values, and scales them. A cell is a small team of people and agents, formed for one piece of work and ended after it. Its roles, rules and work are files anyone can read.

sources.claim: An agile cell is a small team of people and agents, formed for a piece of work and ended after it, with its roles, its rules and its work written down as files anyone can read.
sources.title: agilecells.org, the page as seeded by the AgileCells organisation

sources.claim: Dinis Cruz, 28 November 2026: Agile can scale and go back to its early values.
sources.title: Start prompt of the Agile Cells film

scenes.title: Ten roles, or fifty
scenes.narration: A cell can have ten roles, or twenty, thirty, fifty. Almost a mini company, with its own org chart, for one task.

sources.claim: Dinis Cruz, 28 November 2026: teams of 10, 20, 30, 50 roles, 'almost the creation of a mini company, a mini organisation, a mini full-blown org chart, just to deliver a task'.
sources.title: Start prompt of the Agile Cells film, with Dinis Cruz's words of 28 November 2026

scenes.title: What a cell made
scenes.narration: And here is Agile working. One cell made a real film, How we refresh a session, version after version, in one day.

sources.claim: How we refresh a session: every version, v0.1 onwards, is dated 28 November 2026.
sources.title: How we refresh a session: the production

scenes.on_screen: How we refresh a session, as live cards of its scenes.

scenes.title: We did it
scenes.narration: One person, a lead agent, scene builders, a critic and test viewers. Set up for that one film, and taken down when it is done.

sources.claim: The team that made How we refresh a session: 'One person, one lead agent, and a small cell of sub-agents and outside models set up for this one film and taken down when it is done.'
sources.title: How we refresh a session: the team that made it

sources.claim: The cell's runs, by role, with what each produced.
sources.title: The productions cell: who did what

scenes.on_screen: Dinis Cruz; account C: c.maestro, conductor.c, c.productions with 5 scene-smiths, a critic, 5 test viewers and 2 helper sessions, and design.c, higgsfield.c, accountant.c; account B: b.maestro, higgsfield.b, elevenlabs.b. An agile cell. Archived: its files stay.

scenes.title: Agile, at any size
scenes.narration: So Agile can scale: a cell for each task, built when it is needed, closed when it is done, its files kept. That is Agile Cells.
